description: SAMPLE case file: six synthetic cases, one or two per case type, used to develop and test the evaluation runner. This is NOT the Golden Set and its scores mean nothing.

cases.question: Why does a language model sometimes state things that are not true?
key_facts: The model predicts plausible next tokens rather than checking facts.

cases.question: What are the rungs of the make-or-buy ladder for AI in a company?
key_facts: Make or buy is described as five rungs.

cases.question: How does a perceptron adjust its weights while it learns?
key_facts: The perceptron changes its weights when its output is wrong.

cases.question: What should I put in a request to an AI tool so that the output is useful?
key_facts: A good request states the task and gives context.
